text:
zoe: FYI noticed a weird class of invoke hits in prod where tool responses come back as mixed types and the Console shows a tiny red dot with no context. customers file tickets.

kevin: Can you paste an example? are we marking these as `ambiguous-shape` or outright `invalid`?

zoe: example (redacted):
```
response: { tool: \"search\", output: [\"results\", {\"id\": 123, \"score\": 0.92}] }
validator: expected object for `output`, got array => flagged=ambiguous-shape
routing: fallback -> degen-variant
```

marta: UX ask: surface a compact tooltip in the invocation list explaining what the validator decided, what fallback route was used, and a link to sampled traces (aggregate). e.g. "Validator: unexpected output shape -> auto-fallback to degen. View aggregates."

tariq: infra constraints to remember: we only capture sampled payloads when sampling.rate >= 0.001 and links must respect ACLs (no raw PII for non-admins). deeplink should go to aggregate/redacted view.

kevin: sketch for response envelope metadata so Console can render tooltip:
```
validation_status: "ambiguous-shape",
validation_reason: "output-array-instead-of-object",
fallback_route: "degen-variant",
sample_link: "/console/samples?sid=validator:xyz&view=aggregate"
billing_class: "billed" // or "no_charge"
```

marta: copy suggestion: "Response didn't match the configured tool schema; request routed to a latency-safe fallback. [View aggregated traces]" Also show a small badge for billing: "Billed" or "No charge" and a hover explaining the billing behavior.

zoe: operational note: these soft-fallbacks increment `invoke_soft_rejects` and customers see quota spikes. we need to label whether the event consumed billable quota in the UI.

tariq: backend tasks (rough): add lightweight `validation_*` block to response metadata, populate `billing_class` boolean/string, implement ACL-aware sample_link routing to aggregate pages; toggle sampling rate for canary orgs. estimate: ~2 dev-days + 0.5 ops day.

kevin: frontend tasks: tooltip component showing validator reason, fallback, sample link (aggregate only for non-admins), and billing badge. must be accessible (screen-reader friendly). will mock before EOD.

marta: rollout plan: feature flag `validation-tooltips` canary @5% orgs, bump sampling to 0.01 for 48h in those orgs, product email to customers with >100 soft-fallbacks/day. include FAQ copy: "Why did my request route to a different model?"

ops-bot: incident-4357 created: inv_soft_rejects=1123 last 24h; top orgs: acct-14, acct-99. pipeline queued: `console/feature/validation-tooltips` -> canary-5pct. :clipboard:

tariq: security note: sample_link must never expose raw fields to non-admins. show aggregated metrics or a redacted sample view. ACL gating in the link resolver is required.

kevin: also show a tiny help icon in tooltip linking to docs explaining billing interplay with soft-fallbacks. non-admins see "Billed: hidden (contact billing)" or similar.

marta: accessibility: avoid icon-only badges for billing; include text and aria-labels.

zoe: follow-ups: @tariq please file the backend PR template with schema changes, @kevin attach the mock, @marta draft the customer-facing note. I'll add a task on eng-platform board and link the incident. :shipit:

kevin: mock will include a disabled sample link state for non-admins and a hover explaining ACLs. :white_check_mark:

tariq: will add unit tests for `validation_*` serialization and ACL behavior. estimate posted in the PR.

marta: draft ready for review tomorrow AM.

zoe: thanks everyone — let's track telemetry after canary and iterate on copy if customers are confused.

ops-bot: deploy queued: console/feature/validation-tooltips -> canary-5pct (ETA 02:30 UTC).
